manual.holding_label: manual override active — holding {held}% ({pos_label} would be {position}%)

occupancy.holding: occupancy timeout — holding position {held}% (sun within acceptance angle)
occupancy.label: occupancy timeout active — {pos_label} {position}%

glare.protection: glare zone protection ({zones}) — effective distance {distance:.2f}m{z_suffix} → position {position}%

registry.floor_raised: floor raised winner from {from_pos}% to {to_pos}% by {label}
registry.tilt_applied: tilt-only: slat angle fixed at {tilt}% by {label}; position driven by {handler}
registry.ceiling_lowered: ceiling lowered winner from {from_pos}% to {to_pos}% by {label}
registry.ceiling_inactive: ceiling {ceiling_pos}% inactive (resolved {to_pos}% at or below ceiling)
registry.ceiling_overridden: ceiling {ceiling_pos}% overridden — a floor raised the cover to {to_pos}%
registry.floor_overrides_ceiling: floor raised to {to_pos}% over ceiling {ceiling_pos}% by {label} (winner was {from_pos}%)
registry.bound_yielded_to_hold: bound {low_label}–{high_label} ({axis}) from {label} yielded — priority {priority} does not outrank {holder} ({holder_priority})
registry.hold_position_carried: tilt clamp commands the cover — position held at {position}% (not the would-be {shadow_pos}%)
registry.tilt_bound_active: tilt bound {low_label}–{high_label} active by {label}; awaiting the resolved tilt
registry.tilt_bound_inactive: tilt bound {low_label}–{high_label} inactive by {label}; resolved tilt {tilt}% already within
registry.constraint_outside_window: bound {low_label}–{high_label} ({axis}) from {label} not applied — outside the time window and this slot is not set to stay active
registry.tilt_bound_enforced: tilt bound {low_label}–{high_label} enforced at {tilt}% by {label} (nothing resolved a tilt this cycle)

builder.manual_divergence: manual override active — holding cover at {held}% (solar would be {raw}%)

skip.sun_outside: sun outside acceptance angle or elevation limits
skip.no_glare_zones: no active glare zones or sun outside acceptance angle
skip.cloud_skipped: cloud suppression skipped (sun outside acceptance angle)
skip.cloud_inactive: cloud suppression inactive (direct sun present or feature disabled)
skip.group_scene_not_lock: group intent is a scene, not a lock
skip.group_lock_not_scene: group intent is a lock, not a scene
